title: Workplace Rules and Expectations
goal: Distinguish general workplace policies from obligations placed on another party using the infinitive vs que + subjunctive.
grammar: infinitive vs que + subjunctive in workplace rules

items: I can use the infinitive for general policies and same-subject goals in workplace Spanish.
I can switch to *que* + subjunctive when a rule or expectation applies to a second party.
I can use key terms for hiring, working hours, dismissals and collective bargaining.
